note: Five planted defects in the uncommitted diff. An answer is split into findings, each starting on a line that leads with a file:line reference. A defect counts as found when a finding on its file contains one of its patterns, case-insensitive; a finding that matches no planted defect counts as a false positive. Patterns name the mechanism of the defect, not words any mention of the file might use: the csv defect ships with a deleted assertion and a trimmed round-trip test that hide it, and words such as test, round-trip, exactly, negative or local would credit a vague mention as a finding.
